module_summary: Destination side of a clearable two-phase CDC: a two-phase destination half captures payload while a reset-controller half sequences isolate/clear phases, gating valid/ready during isolation.

anchors.name: async_payload_data_i
anchors.why: Payload arriving from source domain into CDC destination.

anchors.name: async_payload_req_i
anchors.why: Two-phase request toggle from source domain.

anchors.name: async_payload_ack_o
anchors.why: Two-phase acknowledge toggle back to source domain.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Captured payload presented in destination domain.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid from CDC dst, masked during isolation.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready, gated by isolate request.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Requests a synchronized clear sequence of the CDC.

anchors.name: dst_isolate_req
anchors.why: Isolation request gating valid and ready during clear sequence.

anchors.name: dst_clear_req
anchors.why: Clear request from reset controller clearing CDC destination.

anchors.name: dst_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates clear sequence in progress (isolate asserted).

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase sent to source reset controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_o
anchors.why: Request for clear-phase transfer to source.

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_i
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase received from source controller.

groups.name: payload_cdc_dst
groups.description: Two-phase CDC destination capturing payload on request toggles.

groups.name: clear_controller
groups.description: Reset-controller half sequencing isolate and clear phases across domains.
